recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the published FHIR-20612 clarification without changing managingOrganization cardinality or deciding the broader unresolved FHIR-57240 modeling question. Address the FHIR-57231 careTeam terminology correction separately when that R6 technical correction is in scope.
issue_request: FHIR-20612 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification PA change request for EpisodeOfCare. It asked to relax text saying many organizations can be involved but each organization will have its own EpisodeOfCare instance; the approved resolution kept managingOrganization singular and clarified it as the overall responsible party while care may be provided by care teams from different organizations.
initial_application: Historical commit 2bd50df5030ce4f128e582f68bb7b3464829ae61 updated EpisodeOfCare.managingOrganization short, definition, and comment in source/episodeofcare/structuredefinition-EpisodeOfCare.xml, but it did not update source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml. The active introduction therefore still contained the absolute 'will have its own EpisodeOfCare' wording.
additional_context: The linked Zulip Mother/Child record discussion and PA WGM minutes confirm the old wording was meant to be typical rather than a hard business rule. A later Zulip thread showed implementers remained confused by the same Scope statement. FHIR-57231 is a later Resolved - change required correction for the old EpisodeOfCare.team path and FHIR-57240 is a Submitted broader clarification request; both were treated as related context rather than decided issues in this applied/published seed run.
reconciliation: Changed source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml so the Multiple Organizations and Transfer of Care paragraph now says multiple organizations can be involved, identifies EpisodeOfCare.managingOrganization as the primary managing organization, notes care may be provided by care teams from different organizations, and says other organizations may have their own EpisodeOfCare instances.
source_changes: source/episodeofcare/episodeofcare-introduction.xml: replaced the absolute 'each organization will have its own EpisodeOfCare' paragraph with approved non-absolute guidance about the primary managing organization, care teams from other organizations, and optional separate organization-specific EpisodeOfCare instances.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - change required R6 correction to update a historical EpisodeOfCare.team reference to EpisodeOfCare.careTeam; not decided because this run is limited to applied/published source-edit issues.
Submitted broad clarification request about cross-organization EpisodeOfCare use; it confirms the broader topic remains open and should not be resolved by the FHIR-20612 commit.
